video_title: Jalen Duren and Pistons still have NO DEAL 😳 Will he stay in Detroit? 🤔 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren and Pistons currently at an impasse regarding contract extension
quotes.excerpt: the Pistons and Jalen Duren are at an impasse and it's highly up in the air
quotes.quote: The Pistons and Jalen Duren are at an impasse and it's highly up in the air and questionable as to whether he will be reporting and showing up for media day in just seven days. Overall throughout this off-season, both of these sides have been at an impasse where Jalen Duren, when he talks to people close to him, feels a certain way toward the Pistons' respect level for him. For him, it's been all about respect. For the team, it's been about business.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren signing a qualifying offer would be a disaster for Detroit
quotes.excerpt: if he ends up signing that qualifying offer, that is a disaster for Detroit
quotes.quote: If he ends up signing that qualifying offer, that is a disaster for Detroit. You don't take a 180, 190 million dollar gamble to stay. If he signs the qualifying offer, it's to leave, and that is a domino that could lead to some real big problems long-term in Detroit, which the whole reason they've taken this tough stance is because they're trying to keep this young core together.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Detroit Pistons entering training camp under a black cloud
quotes.excerpt: you're going there with a black cloud
quotes.quote: Right now it's disastrous for the Pistons. This is a team that had the number one record in the East and now it's in flux and you're going into camp not happy and excited about what's next, you're going there with a black cloud. You're playing with fire too. There's a lot of money to leave on the table, but then when you say what a man got, he's probably like, well I deserve that. Let's see who blinks in the end.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's short-term focus is on securing his next contract
quotes.excerpt: he's worried about making sure he's healthy and able to sign the contract that he wants
quotes.quote: He's not going to sit out. The worst case scenario is he signs the qualifying offer and he's playing for I believe it's 9.6 million dollars. The problem then is you know he's looking to leave next summer, and you don't even really get him this year, you get a shell of himself who's just, human nature is, he's worried about making sure he's healthy and able to sign the contract that he wants somewhere else next summer, so you don't even get him fully on board this year.
